name: Video games & series
scope: Named video games, paired versions, compilations and game series in Wikidata; English article titles or English/Latin-script source names. One answer per title.
aliases: Use every source alias, normalize case and punctuation, then apply scripts/catalog-aliases.ts; ambiguous aliases never displace another canonical answer.
ranking: Complete October 2026 human pageviews, all access methods, divided by 31 days; absent data remains unknown
refresh: Complete upstream extraction and ranking are refreshed explicitly; unattended builds reproduce this audited, checksum-pinned snapshot.
